cases.question: 分析一下最近30天的销量，你能得出什么结论？
cases.sql: SELECT '本期' AS 周期, SUM(oi.quantity) AS 销量, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS 订单数, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) AS GMV, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.id), 2) AS 客单价 FROM safe.orders AS o JOIN safe.order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.paid_at >= '2026-10-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-11-01' UNION ALL SELECT '上期' AS 周期, SUM(oi.quantity) AS 销量, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS 订单数, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) AS GMV, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.id), 2) AS 客单价 FROM safe.orders AS o JOIN safe.order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.paid_at >= '2026-09-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-10-02' LIMIT 500
cases.summary:
最近30天销量整体好于上期，增长集中在宠物、运动户外和鞋靴。
- 本期销量42162件、订单16075单、GMV 9665990.5元、客单价601.31元，四项均高于上期（40172件、15362单、9095794.04元、592.1元）[查询1]。
- GMV增长最多的是宠物（+122199.08元，+17.6%）、运动户外（+98471.64元，+12.8%）、鞋靴（+77529.6元，+12.4%）；男装下滑最多（-38364.22元，-11.3%）[查询4]。
- 渠道上自然搜索销量10014、GMV 2292288.47元均为最高；站外联盟和品牌广告销量、GMV均低于上期[查询2]。
- 建议：优先给宠物、运动户外、鞋靴补货并加投，同时排查男装下滑商品（如223号、280号）的库存和定价。

cases.question: 最近生意怎么样？
cases.sql: SELECT '本期' AS 周期, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS 订单数, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) AS GMV, SUM(oi.quantity) AS 销量, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.id), 2) AS 客单价 FROM safe.orders AS o JOIN safe.order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.paid_at >= '2026-10-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-11-01' UNION ALL SELECT '上期' AS 周期, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS 订单数, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) AS GMV, SUM(oi.quantity) AS 销量, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.id), 2) AS 客单价 FROM safe.orders AS o JOIN safe.order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.paid_at >= '2026-09-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-10-02' LIMIT 500
cases.summary:
最近30天生意小幅向好，GMV和订单双增。
- 本期GMV 9,665,990.50，上期9,095,794.04；订单16,075单，上期15,362单，客单价601.31 [查询1]。
- 增长主力是宠物（GMV +122,199.08，+17.6%）、运动户外（+98,471.64）、鞋靴（+77,529.60）；男装下滑最多（-38,364.22，-11.3%）[查询5]。
- 渠道上社交种草GMV环比+11.4%、老客复购+9.0%；站外联盟-1.8%、品牌广告-1.7% [查询4]。
- 退款金额本期419,373.63，上期354,683.10，有所上升；退款原因明细因查询次数用尽未取到，无法判断原因 [查询2][查询3]。
- 建议：优先补货并加投宠物热销款209号（+54,340.21），同时排查男装下滑与退款上升的具体原因 [查询6]。

cases.question: 帮我看看退货情况，有什么问题吗？
cases.sql: SELECT r.reason AS 退款原因, SUM(CASE WHEN r.completed_at >= '2026-10-02' AND r.completed_at < '2026-11-01' THEN r.refund_amount ELSE 0 END) AS 本期退款金额, SUM(CASE WHEN r.completed_at >= '2026-09-02' AND r.completed_at < '2026-10-02' THEN r.refund_amount ELSE 0 END) AS 上期退款金额, COUNT(CASE WHEN r.completed_at >= '2026-10-02' AND r.completed_at < '2026-11-01' THEN 1 END) AS 本期退款笔数, COUNT(CASE WHEN r.completed_at >= '2026-09-02' AND r.completed_at < '2026-10-02' THEN 1 END) AS 上期退款笔数, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN r.completed_at >= '2026-10-02' AND r.completed_at < '2026-11-01' THEN r.refund_amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN r.completed_at >= '2026-09-02' AND r.completed_at < '2026-10-02' THEN r.refund_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS 退款金额差值, ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN r.completed_at >= '2026-10-02' AND r.completed_at < '2026-11-01' THEN r.refund_amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN r.completed_at >= '2026-09-02' AND r.completed_at < '2026-10-02' THEN r.refund_amount ELSE 0 END)) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN r.completed_at >= '2026-09-02' AND r.completed_at < '2026-10-02' THEN r.refund_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) * 100, 1) AS 退款金额增长率百分比 FROM safe.refunds AS r WHERE r.status = 'completed' AND ((r.completed_at >= '2026-10-02' AND r.completed_at < '2026-11-01') OR (r.completed_at >= '2026-09-02' AND r.completed_at < '2026-10-02')) GROUP BY r.reason ORDER BY 本期退款金额 DESC LIMIT 500
cases.summary:
退货率整体上升，付费搜索和老客复购渠道恶化最明显。

- 本期退款 419,373.63 元、1,457 笔，退货率 4.3%，上期为 3.9%，退款金额和笔数都在涨 [查询2]。
- 退款原因中“不喜欢”增长最快，金额从 49,530.19 元增至 72,169.61 元，增长 45.7%；“发错货”增长 24.1% [查询1]。
- 渠道退货率：付费搜索从 7.1% 升至 10.6%，老客复购从 9.6% 升至 11.9%，直播带货从 8.0% 升至 10.3% [查询7]。
- 商品维度退货率未算出，因查询次数用完，缺少商品级退货率数据 [查询5/6]。
- 建议：先排查付费搜索和老客复购的投放与选品，并复核“发错货”的发货流程。

cases.question: 下个月我应该重点推哪些商品？
cases.sql: SELECT p.id AS 商品编号, p.name AS 商品名称, p.sku AS SKU, SUM(CASE WHEN r.completed_at >= '2026-10-02' AND r.completed_at < '2026-11-01' THEN r.refund_amount ELSE 0 END) AS 本期退款金额, SUM(CASE WHEN r.completed_at >= '2026-09-02' AND r.completed_at < '2026-10-02' THEN r.refund_amount ELSE 0 END) AS 上期退款金额, SUM(CASE WHEN o.paid_at >= '2026-10-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-11-01' AND o.status <> 'cancelled' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount ELSE 0 END) AS 本期GMV, SUM(CASE WHEN o.paid_at >= '2026-09-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-10-02' AND o.status <> 'cancelled' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount ELSE 0 END) AS 上期GMV FROM safe.products AS p LEFT JOIN safe.order_items AS oi ON oi.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN safe.orders AS o ON o.id = oi.order_id LEFT JOIN safe.refunds AS r ON r.order_item_id = oi.id AND r.status = 'completed' GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.sku HAVING 本期退款金额 > 0 OR 上期退款金额 > 0 ORDER BY 本期退款金额 DESC LIMIT 30
cases.summary:
下月优先推宠物、文具、运动户外的高增长爆款，但需控退款风险。
- 宠物热销款209号本期GMV 142,328.42、环比+61.8%，宠物类目整体+17.6%，量价齐升 [查询4][查询5]
- 文具热销款45号GMV 147,736.23、+59.4%，文具类目+17.3% [查询4][查询5]
- 手机配件204号GMV 130,130.47、+52.5%，但退款10,241.72为全店最高，需先查原因 [查询2][查询4]
- 母婴22号、手机配件185号退款环比大增，不建议加推 [查询2]
- 建议：把209号、45号列入主推并加大曝光，204号先排查退款再决定，母婴22号暂缓。广告ROI数据仅覆盖少数商品，无法判断主推款投放效率。

cases.question: 今天有什么需要我注意的？
cases.sql: SELECT c.name AS 渠道, SUM(CASE WHEN o.paid_at >= '2026-10-31' AND o.paid_at < '2026-11-01' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount ELSE 0 END) AS 本期GMV, SUM(CASE WHEN o.paid_at >= '2026-10-30' AND o.paid_at < '2026-10-31' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount ELSE 0 END) AS 上期GMV, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.paid_at >= '2026-10-31' AND o.paid_at < '2026-11-01' THEN o.id END) AS 本期订单数, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.paid_at >= '2026-10-30' AND o.paid_at < '2026-10-31' THEN o.id END) AS 上期订单数, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN o.paid_at >= '2026-10-31' AND o.paid_at < '2026-11-01' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.paid_at >= '2026-10-31' AND o.paid_at < '2026-11-01' THEN o.id END), 0), 2) AS 本期客单价, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN o.paid_at >= '2026-10-30' AND o.paid_at < '2026-10-31' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.paid_at >= '2026-10-30' AND o.paid_at < '2026-10-31' THEN o.id END), 0), 2) AS 上期客单价, ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN o.paid_at >= '2026-10-31' AND o.paid_at < '2026-11-01' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN o.paid_at >= '2026-10-30' AND o.paid_at < '2026-10-31' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount ELSE 0 END)) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN o.paid_at >= '2026-10-30' AND o.paid_at < '2026-10-31' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) * 100, 1) AS GMV环比变化率 FROM safe.orders AS o JOIN safe.order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id LEFT JOIN safe.channels AS c ON c.id = o.channel_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.paid_at >= '2026-10-30' AND o.paid_at < '2026-11-01' GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY 本期GMV DESC LIMIT 500
cases.summary:
今天退款端明显异常，需优先处理退款和下滑类目。
- 今天 GMV 332451.1、订单 566 单，均高于上期；但客单价从 637.45 降到 587.37，退款金额从 10004.44 升到 15238.27，退货率从 3.1% 升到 4.6% [查询2][查询3]。
- 退款集中在少数单品：运动户外热销款179号 3488.74、美妆热销款77号 2244.38、母婴热销款272号 1358.7 [查询6]。
- 美妆 GMV 降 53.8%、数码降 49.8%、宠物降 33.6%；短视频 GMV 增 64.6%，护肤增 110.9% [查询5][查询1]。
- 建议：先核查上述三款高退款商品的退款原因，再对美妆、数码做流量和转化排查；数据看不出原因，需人工确认。
- 缺数据：广告仅 2 个计划在投，无法判断其他渠道投放是否缺失 [查询4]。

cases.question: 上个月GMV为什么比上上个月低？
cases.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN o.paid_at >= '2026-09-01' AND o.paid_at < '2026-10-01' THEN '上个月' ELSE '上上个月' END AS 期间, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) AS GMV, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS 订单数, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.id), 0) AS 客单价 FROM safe.orders AS o JOIN safe.order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND ((o.paid_at >= '2026-09-01' AND o.paid_at < '2026-10-01') OR (o.paid_at >= '2026-08-01' AND o.paid_at < '2026-09-01')) GROUP BY 期间 LIMIT 500
cases.summary:
上个月GMV并未下滑，反而高于上上个月，问题前提不成立。
- 上个月GMV 9,072,501.5，上上个月8,114,142.58；订单数13,917增至15,345，客单价583.04升至591.24 [查询1]。
- 20个类目中仅宠物GMV减少410.88，其余全部增长，增长最多为运动户外+96,923.79 [查询3]。
- 8个渠道GMV全部增长，最小为品牌广告+42,464.19，最大为付费搜索+178,646.15 [查询4]。
- 退款金额增加约3.1万，但退货率由4.0%降至3.9%，未抵消GMV [查询2]。
- 建议：先确认是否指其他时间段或口径（如剔除退款后的净GMV），再重新分析。

cases.question: 最近30天广告投放效果怎么样，钱花得值吗？
cases.detail: status=ok, source=model, plan=4/4, results=4, dimensions=1/1, 数字未核对
cases.sql: SELECT ads.stat_date AS 统计日期, SUM(ads.spend) AS 广告花费, SUM(ads.attributed_gmv) AS 归因成交金额, ROUND(SUM(ads.attributed_gmv) / NULLIF(SUM(ads.spend), 0), 2) AS ROI FROM safe.ad_daily_stats AS ads WHERE ads.stat_date >= '2026-10-02' AND ads.stat_date < '2026-11-01' GROUP BY ads.stat_date ORDER BY ads.stat_date LIMIT 500
cases.summary:
最近30天广告ROI 1.75，低于上期2.07，投放规模收缩但效率下滑，钱花得不算值。

- 本期花费216,670.86元、归因成交379,574.74元、ROI 1.75；上期花费632,166.00元、ROI 2.07，点击率从2.69%降到1.9%，单均获客成本从62.97元升到72.49元 [查询2]。
- 花费最大的是站外联盟120,349.54元、ROI 1.81；品牌广告66,811.43元、ROI仅1.41；付费搜索ROI最低1.18且单次点击成本3.79元最高 [查询3][查询4]。
- 社交种草ROI最高2.76，但花费仅21,007.22元，占比小 [查询3]。
- 按天看10月9日、13日、14日ROI低至1.27～1.33，10月6日起日花费从约1.2万降到6000～7500元区间 [查询1]。
- 建议：压缩品牌广告和付费搜索预算，把预算向社交种草倾斜，并复盘10月中旬低ROI日期的投放设置。

说明：按天数据只返回前20行，10月22日至31日明细缺失，日度结论仅覆盖已返回部分。

cases.question: 哪个渠道最值得加大投入？
cases.sql: SELECT c.name AS 渠道名称, SUM(CASE WHEN o.paid_at >= '2026-10-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-11-01' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount ELSE 0 END) AS 本期GMV, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.paid_at >= '2026-10-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-11-01' THEN o.id END) AS 本期订单数, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN o.paid_at >= '2026-10-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-11-01' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.paid_at >= '2026-10-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-11-01' THEN o.id END), 0), 2) AS 本期客单价, SUM(CASE WHEN o.paid_at >= '2026-09-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-10-02' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount ELSE 0 END) AS 上期GMV, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.paid_at >= '2026-09-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-10-02' THEN o.id END) AS 上期订单数, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN o.paid_at >= '2026-09-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-10-02' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.paid_at >= '2026-09-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-10-02' THEN o.id END), 0), 2) AS 上期客单价, ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN o.paid_at >= '2026-10-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-11-01' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN o.paid_at >= '2026-09-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-10-02' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount ELSE 0 END)) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN o.paid_at >= '2026-09-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-10-02' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) * 100, 1) AS GMV环比增长率 FROM safe.orders AS o JOIN safe.order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN safe.channels AS c ON c.id = o.channel_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND ((o.paid_at >= '2026-10-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-11-01') OR (o.paid_at >= '2026-09-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-10-02')) GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY 本期GMV DESC LIMIT 500
cases.summary:
社交种草最值得加大投入，ROI和增速都领先。
- 社交种草本期GMV 158.0万，环比+11.4%，增速最快；ROI 2.76为四个投放渠道最高，退款率3.6%偏低 [查询1][查询4][查询2]
- 付费搜索GMV 141.0万、环比+8.6%，但ROI仅1.18、退款率4.8%，效率与质量都偏弱 [查询1][查询4][查询2]
- 站外联盟和品牌广告GMV分别-1.8%、-1.7%，ROI 1.81、1.41，不宜加码 [查询1][查询4]
- 建议：优先把增量预算投向社交种草，小步加投并跟踪ROI与退款率；付费搜索先优化再考虑放量。类目层面只看到部分行，无法判断具体类目机会 [查询3]

cases.question: 本月退款为什么变多了？
cases.sql: SELECT r.reason AS 退款原因, SUM(CASE WHEN r.completed_at >= '2026-10-01' AND r.completed_at < '2026-11-01' THEN r.refund_amount ELSE 0 END) AS 本期退款金额, COUNT(CASE WHEN r.completed_at >= '2026-10-01' AND r.completed_at < '2026-11-01' THEN 1 END) AS 本期退款笔数, SUM(CASE WHEN r.completed_at >= '2026-09-01' AND r.completed_at < '2026-10-01' THEN r.refund_amount ELSE 0 END) AS 上期退款金额, COUNT(CASE WHEN r.completed_at >= '2026-09-01' AND r.completed_at < '2026-10-01' THEN 1 END) AS 上期退款笔数, SUM(CASE WHEN r.completed_at >= '2026-10-01' AND r.completed_at < '2026-11-01' THEN r.refund_amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN r.completed_at >= '2026-09-01' AND r.completed_at < '2026-10-01' THEN r.refund_amount ELSE 0 END) AS 退款金额增长, COUNT(CASE WHEN r.completed_at >= '2026-10-01' AND r.completed_at < '2026-11-01' THEN 1 END) - COUNT(CASE WHEN r.completed_at >= '2026-09-01' AND r.completed_at < '2026-10-01' THEN 1 END) AS 退款笔数增长 FROM safe.refunds AS r WHERE r.status = 'completed' AND ((r.completed_at >= '2026-10-01' AND r.completed_at < '2026-11-01') OR (r.completed_at >= '2026-09-01' AND r.completed_at < '2026-10-01')) GROUP BY r.reason ORDER BY 退款金额增长 DESC LIMIT 500
cases.summary:
本月退款上升主要来自规模增长，原因结构变化集中在“不喜欢”和付费搜索渠道。

- 本月退款 427,809.93 元、1,493 笔，上期 356,867.86 元、1,295 笔；退货率由 3.93% 升至 4.28%，GMV 同期也在增长 [查询4]。
- 退款金额增长最多的是“不喜欢”，增加 24,237.96 元、55 笔；笔数增长最多的是“七天无理由”，增加 59 笔 [查询1]。
- 渠道上付费搜索退款增加 27,222.54 元（+64.5%），直播带货增加 14,699.23 元（+38.4%）[查询2]。
- 商品端手机配件热销款185号增加 7,333.86 元、母婴热销款22号增加 7,045.66 元 [查询3]。
- 建议：先核查付费搜索素材与“不喜欢”相关描述是否一致，并对上述两款商品做详情页和尺码说明复核。数据无法说明退款上升的具体原因。

cases.question: 最近物流有没有拖后腿？
cases.sql: SELECT '本期' AS 周期, COUNT(*) AS 已签收包裹数, ROUND(AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, o.paid_at, s.delivered_at)), 1) AS 平均发货时效小时 FROM safe.orders AS o JOIN safe.shipments AS s ON s.order_id = o.id WHERE NOT s.delivered_at IS NULL AND o.paid_at >= '2026-10-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-11-01' UNION ALL SELECT '上期' AS 周期, COUNT(*) AS 已签收包裹数, ROUND(AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, o.paid_at, s.delivered_at)), 1) AS 平均发货时效小时 FROM safe.orders AS o JOIN safe.shipments AS s ON s.order_id = o.id WHERE NOT s.delivered_at IS NULL AND o.paid_at >= '2026-09-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-10-02' LIMIT 500
cases.summary:
整体物流没有明显拖后腿，但局部省份和韵达需关注。
- 本期已签收 14382 件，平均发货时效 200.7 小时，上期 200.8 小时，基本持平 [查询1]。
- 辽宁 279.1 小时、河南 274.5 小时、河北 274.4 小时、四川 273.5 小时，明显慢于其他省份 177.5–185.1 小时区间 [查询4]。
- 韵达时效由 200.2 升至 201.8 小时，未签收占比由 10.6% 升至 11.3%，是唯一两项都变差的承运商 [查询5]。
- 物流太慢退款 225 笔、65203.46 元，占退款总额 15.5%，占比较上期 16.6% 下降 [查询2]。
- 建议：优先排查辽宁、河南、河北、四川的线路与仓库发货，并对韵达设置时效和未签收占比预警。
- 缺数据：省份维度的上期对比结果未完整返回，无法判断这些省份是否本期新恶化。

cases.question: 各类目最近表现怎么样，哪些在下滑？
cases.sql: SELECT '本期' AS 周期, SUM(r.refund_amount) AS 退款金额 FROM safe.refunds AS r WHERE r.status = 'completed' AND r.completed_at >= '2026-10-02' AND r.completed_at < '2026-11-01' UNION ALL SELECT '上期', SUM(r.refund_amount) FROM safe.refunds AS r WHERE r.status = 'completed' AND r.completed_at >= '2026-09-02' AND r.completed_at < '2026-10-02' LIMIT 500
cases.summary:
整体大盘在涨，但类目级下滑排名缺数据，无法确认哪些类目在下滑。
- 整体本期GMV 9,665,990.5、订单16,075、客单价601.31，均高于上期；退款金额从354,683.1升至419,373.63 [查询1][查询2]。
- 退款增幅最明显的是母婴（81,476.18对34,902.94）、食品（54,284.32对33,318.78）、生鲜（54,132.7对33,573.59）、饮料（43,724.1对27,603.1）[查询3]。
- 商品层面GMV下滑最多：男装热销款193号减30,816.76、箱包热销款15号减26,941.69、鞋靴热销款261号减23,877.09 [查询6]。
- 广告ROI仅数码下滑（1.5降至1.41）；美妆、家居、运动户外、生鲜、饮料本期花费为0，投放效率无法判断 [查询5]。
- 建议：先核查母婴、食品、生鲜、饮料的退款原因，并对上述三款下滑商品做详情页与库存排查。
- 缺失：第2步类目GMV/订单/销量对比失败，类目下滑排名和退货率均未算出 [第2步]。

cases.question: 老客复购情况怎么样？
cases.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN o.paid_at >= '2026-10-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-11-01' THEN '本期' ELSE '上期' END AS 周期, COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS 复购客户数, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS 复购订单数, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount), 2) AS GMV FROM safe.orders AS o JOIN safe.order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN safe.channels AS c ON c.id = o.channel_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND c.name = '老客复购' AND ((o.paid_at >= '2026-10-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-11-01') OR (o.paid_at >= '2026-09-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-10-02')) GROUP BY 周期 ORDER BY 周期 DESC LIMIT 500
cases.summary:
老客复购整体向好，客户数、订单数和GMV均高于上期。
- 老客复购渠道本期复购客户2161人、订单2201单、GMV 1,307,965.05元，上期为2047人、2097单、1,200,070.03元 [查询1]。
- 按注册时间分层，老客本期13,648人下单、16,026单、GMV 9,637,572.32元，客单价601.37元，上期12,539人、14,623单、GMV 8,678,054.22元 [查询2]。
- 渠道上自然搜索复购最强（3725单、3584人、2,219,942.76元），社交种草次之；仅站外联盟复购GMV小幅下降 [查询3]。
- 类目上手机配件、运动户外、宠物老客GMV居前，宠物SKU00209增长52,406.79元最多 [查询4][查询5]。
- 建议：优先补货并加大推广宠物209号、手机配件220号等增长SKU，同时排查站外联盟复购GMV下滑原因。

cases.question: 上个月客单价为什么下降了？
cases.sql: SELECT '本期' AS 期间, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) AS GMV, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS 订单数, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.id), 0) AS 客单价 FROM safe.orders AS o JOIN safe.order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.paid_at >= '2026-09-01' AND o.paid_at < '2026-10-01' UNION ALL SELECT '上期' AS 期间, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) AS GMV, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS 订单数, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.id), 0) AS 客单价 FROM safe.orders AS o JOIN safe.order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.paid_at >= '2026-08-01' AND o.paid_at < '2026-09-01' LIMIT 500
cases.summary:
上个月客单价并未下降，实际从583.04升到591.24。
- 本期GMV 9,072,501.5、订单15,345，均高于上期，客单价591.24高于上期583.04 [查询1]。
- 整体折扣力度两期均为12.5%，件单价226.04对226.32基本持平，不是折扣或低价品拉低 [查询2]。
- 分渠道只有直播带货客单价降25.15（571.96对597.11），自然搜索降0.95，其余渠道均上升 [查询5]。
- 分品类美妆、宠物、家居、文具、母婴、图书客单价下滑，但被手机配件、家纺、护肤等上升抵消 [查询4]。
- 建议：核对“客单价下降”的说法是否指某个渠道或品类，重点看直播带货和美妆的选品与优惠结构；整体层面无需调整。

cases.question: 最近30天哪些地区卖得好，哪些地区需要加强？
cases.sql: SELECT o.province AS 收货省份, COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) AS 签收包裹数, ROUND(AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, o.paid_at, s.delivered_at)), 1) AS 平均发货时效小时 FROM safe.orders AS o JOIN safe.shipments AS s ON s.order_id = o.id WHERE NOT s.delivered_at IS NULL AND o.paid_at >= '2026-10-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-11-01' GROUP BY o.province ORDER BY 平均发货时效小时 DESC LIMIT 500
cases.summary:

- 本期GMV前三：广东1,319,756.49元（-0.7%）、浙江1,091,336.55元（+17.9%）、江苏983,170.28元（+5.9%）[查询2]
- 增长最快：北京+20.7%、浙江+17.9%、河南+16.6%；下滑：江西-9.2%、安徽-4.8%、山东-4.1%[查询2]
- 退款偏高：广东65,795.66元/210单、浙江46,216.04元/150单、上海41,948.68元/125单[查询3]
- 物流偏慢：辽宁279.1小时、河南274.5小时、河北274.4小时、四川273.5小时、陕西272.0小时[查询1]
- 建议：优先排查广东、浙江、上海退款原因；对江西、安徽、山东做促销或投放拉回；辽宁、河南、河北、四川、陕西核查发货与承运商时效。数据未显示下滑和退款的具体原因，需进一步查明细。

cases.question: 童装类目最近怎么样？
cases.sql: SELECT '本期' AS 周期, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) AS GMV, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS 订单数, SUM(oi.quantity) AS 销量, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.id), 2) AS 客单价 FROM safe.orders AS o JOIN safe.order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN safe.products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN safe.categories AS c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE c.name = '童装' AND o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.paid_at >= '2026-10-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-11-01' UNION ALL SELECT '上期' AS 周期, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) AS GMV, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS 订单数, SUM(oi.quantity) AS 销量, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.id), 2) AS 客单价 FROM safe.orders AS o JOIN safe.order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN safe.products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN safe.categories AS c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE c.name = '童装' AND o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.paid_at >= '2026-09-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-10-02' LIMIT 500
cases.summary:
童装类目最近30天整体向好，GMV和订单双增，退款率下降。

- 本期GMV 471,987.38，订单1,566，销量2,177，客单价301.40，四项均高于上期 [查询1]。
- 贡献最大为SKU00208（GMV 139,709.12）和SKU00095（101,483.49）；下滑最多为SKU00202（减少3,556.36）[查询3]。
- 老客复购增长最快（GMV 72,172.34，环比+41.7%）；站外联盟（-23.7%）和品牌广告（-24.8%）下滑明显 [查询2]。
- 退款率3.1%，较上期3.7%下降；退款金额最高为尺码不符（17笔，3,951.26）[查询4][查询5]。
- 建议：优先补强尺码说明与选码引导，同时加大老客复购和短视频投放，排查站外联盟与品牌广告下滑原因。
